exposure: Estimated fetal weight (EFW) measured by ultrasonography
cohort: 270 newborns whose electronic records were retrieved to compare estimated fetal weight with actual birth weight.
finding: Antenatal ultrasonography measurements of estimated fetal weight show high compatibility with actual birth weight, despite a slight overestimation.
cross-section timing: Estimated fetal weight was measured on the day of delivery or the day before, and actual birth weight was measured immediately after delivery.
